decisions.minimumMissingWitness: Supply/authorize the complete Ascension form, insight and lifecycle specification; then demonstrate one full useful transformed-body encounter and one useful insight encounter across the two actual school routes, including alignment change/Lock/protection, gear, suppression, expiry and fit cleanup.

A finite duration and concentration choice that reconciles native Instantaneous with temporary avatar, with alignment-change, incapacitation/death, suppression, dispel/replacement and safe return/end rules.
A useful divine-insight contract: source-qualified subjects and fields, reach, update/action/resource cadence and protection/undefined-information handling, without omniscience.

Exact Alignment Avatar and Alignment Immunity envelopes are available. Their profile and protection scope are comparison facts, not an Ascension grant.
